title: AtScale Cube Query Latency p95
app: AtScale engine query logs and the AtScale API via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=atscale:query status="SUCCESS"
| eval dur_s=round(query_ms/1000,2)
| stats avg(dur_s) as avg_s, p95(dur_s) as p95_s, count as runs by cube_name
| where p95_s>10
| sort - p95_s
description: Computes the 95th-percentile query latency for each cube in AtScale and flags the slowest, pointing owners at the specific content or jobs that need optimisation.
value: Tail latency, not the average, is what users feel; ranking AtScale cubes by p95 focuses tuning effort where it removes the most pain.
implementation: Ingest AtScale timing data; schedule daily over a trailing week and review the slowest cubes with their owners.
visualization: Table of cube by p95 query latency, trend line.
grandmaExplanation: We measure how slow the worst cases are in AtScale so the sluggish ones get fixed before people give up on them.
